name: Quietline
one_liner: Encrypted on-chain mail on Starknet. Payment memos ride the same private transfer.
readme_hash:
8772:# Quietline

Encrypted on-chain mail on Starknet.

Addresses never appear on the message. Content decrypts only on the
recipient's device. A private transfer can carry a memo in the same
transaction —
summary: Send and receive encrypted messages on Starknet without revealing identities.
description_long: Quietline allows users to send encrypted messages via Starknet, where both sender and recipient identities remain hidden. The project leverages privacy-enhancing techniques to ensure that messages are decrypted only on the recipient's device, with the added option to send payment memos in the same private transactions. This challenges developers to ensure security while functioning on a public chain, effectively balancing anonymity with usability.
latest_push: Added chain evidence and mailbox restore UI along with escrow settlement.
